premise: The ship and the booster need fuel to fly again and there's no fuel station on the Moon, so the excavator fetches crater ice — which can be split into rocket fuel.
inspiration: 'Aladdin' from 'The Arabian Nights', where a lamp holds a wish-granting genie, turned: no lamp and no genie — the magic is real chemistry, hidden in the ice.
lesson: What you need may already be right under your feet.
learning: Ice from the Moon can be split into the gases rockets burn as fuel.

en-US.title: Fuel from Ice
en-US.text: The huge {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} ship and the tall {booster:enter} {booster:go to pad} booster stood side by side on the landing pad. Their tanks were nearly empty. {ship:wobble} And there's no fuel station on the Moon. {booster:wobble} [curious] But the Moon has something else, hidden in its coldest, darkest craters. The {excavator:enter} excavator trundled down {excavator:go to crater} into the crater, and there, frozen in the dust, was a big chunk of {ice:enter} ice. It glittered in the dark. {ice:live} Frost spread over it, white and sparkling. {excavator:live} Scoop! {sfx:scoop} Up came the ice, and back trundled the excavator {excavator:go to ship} with a full load. Ice is made of water. And water can be split into two gases: the very same ones rockets burn. {excavator:pulse} [excited] Into the tanks it went. {ship:sparkle} Enough for the ship. {booster:sparkle} Enough for the booster too! {ship:live hold} {sfx:whirr} The ship lowered its crew elevator, ready for the trip home. [proudly] {all:face happy} {all:hop} Everyone cheered. {excavator:hop} Fuel from the Moon itself!

es-ES.title: Combustible de hielo
es-ES.text: La enorme {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} nave y el alto {booster:enter} {booster:go to pad} cohete propulsor esperaban juntos en la plataforma de aterrizaje. Tenían los depósitos casi vacíos. {ship:wobble} Y en la Luna no hay gasolineras. {booster:wobble} [curious] Pero la Luna tiene otra cosa, escondida en sus cráteres más fríos y oscuros. La {excavator:enter} excavadora bajó traqueteando {excavator:go to crater} al cráter, y allí, congelado en el polvo, había un gran trozo de {ice:enter} hielo. Brillaba en la oscuridad. {ice:live} La escarcha lo cubrió, blanca y reluciente. {excavator:live} ¡Palada! {sfx:scoop} Arriba fue el hielo, y la excavadora volvió {excavator:go to ship} con la pala llena. El hielo es agua. Y el agua se puede separar en dos gases: justo los que queman los cohetes. {excavator:pulse} [excited] Todo fue a los depósitos. {ship:sparkle} Suficiente para la nave. {booster:sparkle} ¡Y para el cohete también! {ship:live hold} {sfx:whirr} La nave bajó su ascensor, lista para el viaje a casa. [proudly] {all:face happy} {all:hop} Todos lo celebraron. {excavator:hop} ¡Combustible de la propia Luna!

scoop.prompt: a machine scooping up a chunk of ice and gritty soil, a crunchy scrape

whirr.prompt: a smooth mechanical whir of a big elevator platform lowering, gentle hum
